title: Flame Graph & pprof Viewer
description: Flame graph viewer for CPU and memory profiles: .cpuprofile, .heapprofile, Chrome trace JSON, Go pprof (.pb.gz), collapsed stacks, perf script and speedscope files. Search, zoom, time order and left heavy, a function table and click to source. Offline.

title: iCalendar Viewer & ICS, vCard
description: iCalendar viewer for VS Code: open .ics and .ifb files as a calendar with month, week and agenda views, time zones and repeating events, and .vcf vCard files as contact cards. Works offline.

title: DMN Decision Table Editor
description: DMN editor for VS Code: open .dmn files (DMN 1.1 to 1.6) as decision tables, a decision requirements diagram and literal expressions, edit them and save the same XML with Camunda and other vendor attributes kept. Offline, no account.

title: Subtitles & SRT Editor, VTT
description: Subtitles editor for SRT, WebVTT, ASS, SSA and SBV files: an editable cue table in sync with the text, your local video beside it with the cues on the picture, and checks for overlaps, reading speed and long lines. Offline.

title: Blood, Sweat and Code
description: A cheerful pastel-purple coding companion for ARMY. Track sweat (keystrokes), blood (bugs squashed) and code (lines), with pixel hearts, a 7 burst, BTS sounds, and easter eggs. Fan-made by @tipandtale. Not affiliated with HYBE or BTS.

title: FASTQ & FASTA Viewer, VCF, SAM
description: FASTQ viewer and FASTA viewer for VCF, SAM, BED and GFF files, plain or .gz: a fast paged table for files of several GB, colored bases, quality bars, GC percent and motif search. It never changes your color theme.

title: Org Mode Viewer & Org Preview
description: Org mode viewer for VS Code: a live Org preview beside the editor with folding headings, TODO states and checkboxes you can click, tables, links, pictures and colored code, plus syntax highlighting and an outline of headings. Offline.

title: CamposCloud
description: Manage CamposCloud applications, files and databases and watch the live console without leaving VS Code.

title: Nailong
description: Adds a tiny, unofficial Nailong to your status bar

title: Fairy Dust: Git Push Sound
description: Plays an audio clip on git push

title: Read Aloud: Claude Code Response (Terminal)
description: Read Claude Code's latest terminal response aloud, with pause and stop controls.

title: Open in Dinkus
description: Open Markdown files in the Dinkus markdown studio for macOS from the Explorer, the editor, or the editor title bar.

title: NJF Theme
description: GitHub Dark with expressive Primer colours and Python semantic highlighting.
